title: How Good Is The God We Adore
firstLine: How good is the God we adore,

lines: How good is the God we adore,
Our faithful unchangeable Friend,
Whose love is as great as His power
And knows neither measure nor end.
How boundless the grace He hath shown
In giving Himself on the tree
For sinners condemned and undone,
Unworthy of mercy so Free!
How glorious to walk in the light
He sendest from heaven above,
To lean on His infinite might
And rest in His unfailing love!
'Tis Jesus, the First and the Last,
Whose Spirit shall guide us safe home;
We'll praise Him for all that is past
And trust him for all that's to come.
How great is Thy goodness, O Lord!
How grand and how glorious Thy name!
In earth and in heaven adored,
Redeemer and Savior of men!
